theater: 頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克州

battle.name: 頓巴斯戰爭
battle.theater: 頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克州
battle.brief: 二〇一四年四月十三日，烏克蘭在頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩州對親俄武裝發動反恐行動，交火延續至今。卡面這門一八六〇年人力轉動的六管加特林機槍未曾在頓巴斯上陣，卻是現代轉管機關炮的源頭：其血統延續為 GSh-6-30 與 M134 迷你砲，後者曾架在二〇一四年七月墜落的米八上。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 二〇一四年四月起在頓巴斯進行的這場戰爭，交戰的雙方是烏克蘭國家一方與宣稱獨立的兩個「人民共和國」一方，中間還夾雜著俄羅斯軍隊的介入。烏克蘭方面由內政部轄下的特種警察部隊、國家安全局武裝、二〇一四年三月成立並在四月改組的國民警衛隊，以及烏克蘭武裝部隊的野戰單位組成，志願營是最早投入的骨幹：亞速營、別動營、第聶伯河營等由地方警務、退役軍人與網絡義烏組建。作戰由二〇一四年四月十三日成立的「反恐行動」司令部統一指揮，最初歸內政部與安全局主管，其後歸國防部與總參謀長，戰區分屬北部與南部軍區，防線沿頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克兩州的城鎮與鐵路展開。分離主義一方在頓涅茨克州於四月組成「頓涅茨克人民共和國」，在盧甘斯克州於四月成立「盧甘斯克人民共和國」，其武裝核心是從內務部警察與「金雕」特警部隊改編而成的「東方」營，以及由俄語志願者組成的「堡壘」營等；兩個政權都得到俄羅斯的人員、資金與技術援助，俄軍第五十三獨立摩托化步兵旅、空降兵部隊與第三十四集團軍先後進入烏克蘭境內，但俄羅斯官方始終否認直接參戰。戰線之外，歐安組織與聯合國的核查團在兩州部署觀察員，二〇一四年四月簽訂的《明斯克協議》第一階段由烏克蘭、俄羅斯與兩個「共和國」共同斡旋。
countriesEn: The war that began in Donbas in April 2014 was fought between the Ukrainian state on one side and two self-declared people's republics on the other, with the intervention of Russian forces running through the middle of it. On the Ukrainian side the forces were drawn from the special police units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the armed men of the Security Service of Ukraine, the National Guard, which was created in March 2014 and reorganised in April, and the field units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine; volunteer battalions formed the earliest backbone, with Azov, Aidar, Dnipro-1 and others assembled from local police, demobilised servicemen and volunteers recruited through the internet. Operations were directed by the Anti-Terrorist Operation command post set up on 13 April 2014, which began under the Ministry of Internal Affairs and the security service and later passed to the Ministry of Defence and the General Staff; the theatre was split between the Northern and Southern military districts, and the line ran through the towns and the rail links of the Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts. On the separatist side, the Donetsk People's Republic was organised in the Donetsk oblast in April and the Luhansk People's Republic in the Luhansk oblast in the same month; their armed core was the Vostok Battalion, reconstituted from the internal police and the Berkut special police detachment, joined by formations such as the Oplot Battalion raised from Russian-speaking volunteers. Both entities drew on Russian personnel, money and technical assistance, and Russian units — the 53rd Separate Motor Rifle Brigade, airborne formations and the 34th Army — entered Ukrainian territory in the months that followed, while Moscow consistently denied taking part directly. Outside the line, monitors of the OSCE and the United Nations were deployed in the two oblasts, and the first Minsk Protocol of April 2014 was mediated jointly by Ukraine, Russia and the two republics.
people: 烏克蘭方面最關鍵的決策者是二〇一四年二月二十三日出任代理總統的奧列克桑德·圖爾切諾夫，他在四月把總統、總理與安全局長三職合一，直接主持「反恐行動」並親赴前線；總理尤利婭·季莫申科在二〇一四年六月下台前主導了與俄方的外交接觸，亞爾謝尼·亞岑紐克接任總理後把國家預算與軍備開支推向戰時軌道。軍隊方面，總參謀長安德烈·坦齊烏拉、國防部副部長兼空降兵指揮官伊霍爾·捷紐克主持了二〇一四年夏季的南部反攻；北部軍區指揮官阿納托利·克瓦什紐克負責左翼防務，國民警衛隊與亞速營指揮官安德烈·別列茨基、主力營指揮官季莫費·博先科等人守住了馬里烏波爾的鋼鐵廠。分離主義一方，頓涅茨克「總理」帕維爾·古巴列夫是頓涅茨克公民議會的主席，阿列克謝·莫茲戈沃依在「東方」營與沃斯托克營的組建中居功至巨，二〇一四年五月他在一架被擊落的米八上身亡；八月接掌頓涅茨克「總理」的是亞歷山大·扎哈爾琴科，盧甘斯克方面則是瓦列里·博洛托夫與其後繼任的伊戈爾·普洛特尼茨基。俄羅斯方面，總統弗拉基米爾·普京自二〇一四年三月的克里米亞演說起主導整體政策，前格魯情報官伊戈爾·斯特列科夫以頓巴斯游擊隊發言人的身份出場，成為分離武裝最具象徵性的指揮者。停火與談判層面，波蘭總統佩特·科羅申科、俄羅斯總統普京與白俄羅斯總統盧卡申科在二〇一四年九月與二〇一五年二月的明斯克會議中是最主要的談判對手。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the Ukrainian side was Oleksandr Turchynov, who became acting President on 23 February 2014; in April he held the posts of president, prime minister and head of the security service at once, personally directing the Anti-Terrorist Operation and travelling to the front. Prime Minister Yulia Tymoshenko led the diplomatic contact with Moscow until she left office in June 2014, and her successor Arseniy Yatsenyuk pushed the state budget and the arms budget onto a wartime footing. In the armed forces, Chief of the General Staff Andriy Tantsiura and Deputy Defence Minister and airborne commander Ihor Tenyuk directed the southern counter-offensive of the summer of 2014; Northern Military District commander Anatoliy Kvashnyuk handled the left flank, and National Guard and Azov commanders such as Andriy Biletsky and battalion commander Denys Prokopenko held the steel works at Mariupol. On the separatist side, Donetsk 'prime minister' Pavel Gubarev was the chairman of the Donetsk People's Council; Aleksey Mozgovoy did the most to build the Vostok and Oplot formations and was killed in a downed Mi-8 in May 2014; Alexander Zakharchenko took over as Donetsk 'prime minister' in August, while in Luhansk the figureheads were Valery Bolotov and, after him, Igor Plotnitsky. On the Russian side, President Vladimir Putin drove the whole policy from the Crimea address of March 2014, and Igor Strelkov, a former intelligence officer, appeared as the spokesman of the Donbas insurgents and became the most emblematic commander of the separatist armed forces. At the level of ceasefire and negotiation, Polish President Petro Poroshenko, Russian President Putin and Belarusian President Lukashenko were the principal interlocutors at the Minsk meetings of September 2014 and February 2015.
kits: 卡面是一八六〇年的加特林機槍：六根槍管由人力曲柄帶動旋轉，彈藥由中央供彈機構輸送，每分鐘射擊數百發，採用當年的槍械彈與早期金屬被甲彈。它在本場戰爭中沒有任何一個環節，但它是現代「轉管機關炮」技術譜系的源頭：十九世紀末的Maxim與維克斯轉管砲、一九二〇年代的蘇制GSh-6-30、今天的美製M134迷你砲與GAU-21、俄製2A42，都沿用同一個「多管旋轉、連續供彈」的原理。加特林的血脈在頓巴斯以兩種方式出現：其一在天空，烏克蘭與俄羅斯的米八與米二十四直升機都掛有GSh-6-30三十毫米三管機關炮，烏軍AH-1S「喀什維爾」配可俯仰的M197炮塔與GAU-12.7迷你砲，AH-64D則配GAU-21三管機關炮；其二在地面，俄軍T-72與T-90主力坦克的2A42三十毫米機關炮、BMP-2的三十毫米炮，以及架在皮卡技術車與UAZ上的GSh-6-30或ZU-23-2雙管機關炮，都是同一門血統的地面版本。步兵方面，交戰雙方以AK-74M、AKM、PKM、DShK重機槍、AGS-17自動槍與RPG系列火箭筒為主；砲兵部署2A14、2A18「風暴」一五〇毫米自行榴彈炮、BM-21「冰雹」火箭炮、2S3「金剛草」與2S19「Msta」自行榴彈炮，反裝甲武器使用9M113、9M14米格反坦克導彈與車載9K35、9K57飛彈發射車；防空一方有S-300、S-125與TOS-1噴射砲。空中支援由Su-25近距支援機、MiG-29、Bayraktar TB2無人機與攜帶刺針-3巡飛彈的直升機及戰機構成，烏軍還大量使用有線光纖飛行器與小四旋翼掛載火箭筒。
kitsEn: The card shows the Gatling gun of 1860: six barrels turned by a hand crank, ammunition fed from a central mechanism, several hundred rounds a minute, firing the rifle cartridges and early metal-jacketed ammunition of the period. It had no place of its own in this war, but it is the source of the modern rotary-cannon lineage: the Maxim and Vickers rotary guns of the late nineteenth century, the Soviet GSh-6-30 of the 1920s, today's American M134 minigun and GAU-21, and the Russian 2A42 all use the same principle of multiple barrels in rotation with continuous feed. The Gatling bloodline appears in Donbas in two ways. First in the air: both the Ukrainian and Russian Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters carry the GSh-6-30 thirty-millimetre three-barrel gun, the Ukrainian AH-1S Chimera flies the traverse-and-elevate M197 turret with the GAU-12.7 minigun, and the AH-64D carries the three-barrel GAU-21. Second on the ground: the 2A42 thirty-millimetre gun of the Russian T-72 and T-90 main battle tanks, the thirty-millimetre gun of the BMP-2, and the GSh-6-30 or ZU-23-2 twin guns mounted on pickup technicals and UAZ vans are the ground versions of the same lineage. For the infantry, both sides fought with AK-74M and AKM rifles, PKM and DShK heavy machine guns, AGS-17 automatic guns and RPG-series launchers. The artillery deployed the 2A14 and the 2A18 Smerch one-hundred-and-fifty-millimetre self-propelled howitzer, the BM-21 Grad rocket launcher, and the 2S3 Akatsia and 2S19 Msta self-propelled howitzers; anti-armour weapons were the 9M113 and 9M14 Malyutka guided missiles and the vehicle-mounted 9K35 and 9K57 launchers. On the air-defence side stood the S-300 and the S-125, together with the TOS-1 flamethrower system. Air support came from Su-25 close air support aircraft, MiG-29 fighters, Bayraktar TB2 unmanned aircraft and helicopters and fighters carrying Lancet-3 loitering munitions, while the Ukrainian side also used large numbers of fibre-optic tethered drones and small quadcopters carrying rocket launchers.
tactics: 頓巴斯的地面作戰從二〇一四年春天起就以「封鎖城鎮、分割武裝」為主軸。烏軍最初以特種部隊小組插入、以小車隊巡邏代替大縱隊前進，結果在七月二十二日斯洛維揚斯克外的一場伏擊中損失慘重：當日俄軍以地空導彈擊落一架載有武裝傘兵的米八直升機，機上乘員全部陣亡，該機側掛的十二點七毫米轉管機關炮正是加特林血統的近親。烏軍轉而組織裝甲縱隊沿公路突進，八月在伊洛瓦伊斯克與馬爾基夫卡一線，第4裝甲旅、第93與第95機械旅、第8摩托化步兵旅與國民警衛隊一部被分割包圍，數百輛坦克與裝甲車被繳獲或摧毀，這是二〇一四年烏軍最大的一次地面挫敗。分離武裝則以「衝擊群」打法著稱：二〇一四年七月五日在波羅賓卡附近以數百名武裝人員強攻戈爾洛夫卡與科斯堅季尼夫卡，切入第4裝甲旅防線的側翼；其機動以技術車隊、卡車與輕型裝甲車為主，縱隊沒有完善後勤，靠沿線徵用燃料與彈藥維持戰鬥。二〇一五年一月德爾巴爾切沃方向，分離武裝以一條狹長走廊切斷烏軍在斯維洛達爾斯克與德爾巴爾切沃之間的補給線，烏軍戰車縱隊在回撤途中被擊毀，市區於二月二日淪陷，此役成為《明斯克協議》第二階段的主要背景。二〇二二年全面入侵後戰線形態再變：烏軍以縱深炮火與無人機打擊裝甲縱隊，俄軍以巡飛彈、反衝鋒與熱成像瞄準具對付火力點，馬里烏波爾鋼鐵廠的圍攻延續數週，與二〇一四年同一座廠房的攻防形成對照。
tacticsEn: Ground operations in Donbas were built from the spring of 2014 around the axis of blockading the towns and cutting the armed groups apart. At first the Ukrainian army went in with small insertions by special forces and with patrols by small vehicle columns instead of pushing large formations down the road, and it paid dearly in an ambush outside Sloviansk on 22 July: a Mi-8 carrying armed paratroopers was downed that day by a surface-to-air missile, every person on board being killed, and the side-mounted twelve-point-seven-millimetre rotary cannon that the aircraft carried was a close relative of the Gatling bloodline. The army then turned to pushing armoured columns along the roads, and in August, along the line at Ilovaisk and Marinka, the 4th Armoured Brigade, the 93rd and 95th Mechanised Brigades, the 8th Motorised Infantry Brigade and part of the National Guard were cut off and surrounded, several hundred tanks and armoured vehicles being captured or destroyed; this was the largest ground reverse of the Ukrainian army in 2014. The separatist forces were known for shock-group tactics: on 5 July 2014 several hundred fighters attacked Horlivka and Kostiantynivka near Pokrovske, cutting into the flank of the 4th Armoured Brigade's line. Their mobility rested on technicals, trucks and light armoured vehicles, columns without proper logistics, kept in the fight by taking fuel and ammunition along the line. In January 2015, in the Debaltseve direction, the separatists cut the supply road between Svitlodarsk and Debaltseve with a narrow corridor, Ukrainian armoured columns were destroyed in flight during the withdrawal, and the town fell on 2 February; that offensive became the main background to the second Minsk Protocol. After the full-scale invasion of 2022 the shape of the line changed again: the Ukrainian side used deep fires and drones against armoured columns, the Russian side used loitering munitions, counter-attacks and thermal imaging sights against firing points, and the siege of the Mariupol steel works dragged on for weeks, forming a direct contrast with the fighting around the same plant in 2014.
data: 可核對的數字集中在時間、兵力與裝備損失三處。時間：自二〇一四年四月十三日烏方宣布啟動「反恐行動」起算，二〇一四年四月至二〇一五年二月為高強度交火期，二〇一五年二月十五日起按《明斯克協議》第二階段維持停火但交火未停，二〇二二年二月二十四日俄軍全面入侵後再度升級。兵力：二〇一四年夏季烏方在戰區的正規部隊與志願營合計約四萬人，分離武裝在二〇一四年四月盧甘斯克方向首次大規模集結時，官方宣稱四千人，外部估計二千至三千人；盧甘斯克「人民共和國」二〇一四年七月攻擊烏軍防線時投入兵力被烏方估為二千至三千人。防線：《明斯克》停火線全長約五百至六百公里，其後築起上千公里的塹壕體系。裝備損失：二〇一四年八月伊洛瓦伊斯克方向，烏方損失坦克與裝甲車數百輛，數百名作戰人員陣亡或被俘；二〇一四年七月十九日一架掛有烏克蘭國旗的米八直升機在盧甘斯克機場附近被地空導彈擊落，機上機組人員全部陣亡，七月二十二日另一架載有武裝傘兵的米八在斯洛維揚斯克方向同樣被擊落，機上乘員全部陣亡，其中包括數名國家安全局人員。空軍：Su-25近距支援機在二〇一四年至二〇一五年間損失數架；二〇一四年五月二十六日一架載有分離武裝人員的米八在多庫恰耶夫斯克方向被肩扛式防空導彈擊落。上述數字多為各方自行公布，歐安組織核查團的報告亦指出雙方都有大量裝備在無記錄的情況下流失。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster in three places: time, strength and equipment losses. On time: counting from the announcement by the Ukrainian side on 13 April 2014 that the Anti-Terrorist Operation had begun, April 2014 to February 2015 was the period of heavy fighting; from 15 February 2015 the ceasefire of the second Minsk Protocol was meant to hold, although shelling continued; and after the full-scale Russian invasion of 24 February 2022 the tempo rose again. On strength: in the summer of 2014 the regular Ukrainian units and volunteer battalions in the theatre together numbered about forty thousand men; when the separatist forces first massed in strength in the Luhansk direction in April 2014 their own claim was four thousand, while outside estimates put them at two to three thousand; the force the Luhansk People's Republic committed to the assault on the Ukrainian line in July 2014 was put by the Ukrainian side at two to three thousand men. On the line: the Minsk ceasefire line runs about five hundred to six hundred kilometres, and behind it a trench system of more than a thousand kilometres was dug. On equipment losses: in the Ilovaisk direction in August 2014 the Ukrainian side lost several hundred tanks and armoured vehicles and several hundred soldiers were killed or taken prisoner; on 19 July 2014 a Mi-8 flying a Ukrainian flag was downed by a surface-to-air missile near Luhansk airfield, the whole crew being killed, and on 22 July another Mi-8 carrying armed paratroopers was shot down in the Sloviansk direction, every person on board being killed, among them several officers of the Security Service of Ukraine. In the air: a number of Su-25 close air support aircraft were lost between 2014 and 2015, and on 26 May 2014 a Mi-8 carrying separatist personnel was hit by a man-portable air defence missile in the Dokuchaievsk direction. Most of these numbers were published by the parties themselves; the reports of the OSCE monitors also note that large quantities of equipment on both sides went missing without any record.
cause: 打起來有五層原因。第一層是烏克蘭東部的社會與政治結構：頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩州在蘇聯時期是重工業與煤炭產區，城市化程度高、俄語作為日常語言，在二〇一四年之前長期享有較高的社會福利與退休待遇，這些記憶在二〇一三年之後成為分離主義的土壤；歐洲協會條約未能簽署、語言法案與歷史記憶的爭議，則是烏克蘭全國層面的分歧。第二層是二〇一四年初的權力真空與俄烏關係的破裂：亞努科維奇在雅爾達被推翻，烏克蘭入約與自由貿易的期望落空，舊蘇聯邊境劃界條約未獲批准，二〇一三年九月後烏克蘭中斷了與俄羅斯的若干軍貿合作；三月三日克里米亞國際機場被武裝人員佔領，俄軍隨後進駐，三月十六日普京發表演說並簽署條約把克里米亞併入俄羅斯，聯合國安理會三月廿七日以一百三十一票對十一票通過第六十八號決議重申烏克蘭的領土完整，但沒有任何強制手段。第四層是三月五日《天際線協議》與三月七日歐洲與美國外長聲明所劃定的談判框架失敗：協議只規定解除武裝而沒有安排政治程序，俄方主張由「全烏克蘭人民」投票決定地區地位，烏克蘭中央政府則堅持主權與既有邊界，雙方的根本分歧無法用技術條文彌合。第五層是分離武裝的實際成形：從三月起，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩州出現大量群眾集會，地方議會被奪取，武裝查封軍械庫並襲擊警崗，四月十一日頓涅茨克「公民議會」宣布成立「人民共和國」並要求俄羅斯「護衛」；烏方中央政府則以收回武器與恢復秩序為由出動內政部部隊，反恐行動於是成為雙方軍事對撞的起點。
causeEn: There were five layers of cause. The first was the social and political structure of eastern Ukraine: the Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts were heavy industry and coal regions in the Soviet period, highly urbanised, with Russian as the everyday language, and until 2014 they enjoyed comparatively high social benefits and pensions; those memories became the soil of separatism after 2013. The failure to sign the Association Agreement, the language legislation and the disputes over historical memory were the disagreements at the level of the whole country. The second layer was the vacuum of power in early 2014 and the breakdown of relations between Russia and Ukraine: Yanukovych was overthrown in Kyiv, the hopes of accession and of a free trade agreement collapsed, the treaty demarcating the former Soviet border was never ratified, and after September 2013 Ukraine suspended a number of military trade arrangements with Russia. On 3 March armed men occupied the Simferopol airport in Crimea and Russian troops moved in afterwards; on 16 March Putin delivered his address and signed the instruments annexing Crimea to Russia, and on 27 March the Security Council adopted resolution 68/262 by 131 votes to 11, reaffirming the territorial integrity of Ukraine, but with no coercive measure behind it. The fourth layer was the failure of the negotiating frame set by the Skyline agreement of 5 March and the statement of the European and American foreign ministers of 7 March: the agreement provided only for the disarming of formations and made no political arrangement, Russia pressed for the status of the territories to be settled by a vote of the entire population of Ukraine, and the central Ukrainian government held to sovereignty and the existing borders, so the fundamental disagreement could not be bridged by technical clauses. The fifth layer was the actual formation of the separatist armed groups: from March there were mass gatherings in the Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts, local councils were taken over, armed men raided police stations and seized depots, and on 11 April the Donetsk People's Council proclaimed a 'people's republic' and asked Russia for 'protection'; the central government in Kyiv moved interior ministry troops to recover weapons and restore order, and the Anti-Terrorist Operation thus became the starting point of the military collision between the two sides.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果分四層。第一層是烏克蘭的國家改造：二〇一四年之後軍隊全面改革，志願營與內政部部隊被收編進武裝部隊，裝備大量換裝為北約標準，無人機部隊與特種作戰司令部相繼成立，二〇一五年起實行職業化合同與國防預算大幅上升；國民警衛隊與安全部門的分工被重新劃分，烏克蘭安全部隊的戰鬥經驗成為其軍事改革的推動力。第二層是國際秩序：這是二戰後歐洲第一次大規模的國家間戰爭，歐安組織的核查機制與《明斯克協議》成為此後國際干預與停火設計常被援引的範本，同時把歐洲安全的地緣分割重新固定在東翼；俄羅斯的克里米亞兼併與其後的干預，被西方主流安全機構視為二戰後歐洲秩序的破壞，歐盟與美國的制裁、歐洲軍費上升、北約在東翼的軍力部署都以此為由。第三層是頓巴斯本身的社會：兩個「共和國」維持了事實上的政權，以軍事物資換取承認的灰色經濟運作，學校改用俄語教學，護照與貨幣逐步與俄羅斯接軌；戰線上的居民長期生活在砲擊、斷電與檢查站之下，數百萬人流離失所，志願兵與僱傭兵的再生產成為當地經濟的一部分。第四層是戰爭形態的改變：二〇一四年之後的這條戰線由實時傳輸的無人機畫面、社交媒體與影片剪輯所主導，第一次讓戰爭的全貌在開火現場即時進入全球輿論，戰爭的宣傳、記憶與正當性爭奪從此與火力同等重要；而二〇二二年二月二十四日的全面入侵，正是以頓巴斯戰爭作為其軍事與政治前提。
impactEn: The consequences of the war fall into four layers. The first is the remaking of the Ukrainian state: after 2014 the armed forces were comprehensively reformed, volunteer battalions and interior ministry units were folded into the regular army, equipment was largely resupplied to NATO standards, drone forces and a command for special operations were established, and from 2015 professional contracts and a steep rise in the defence budget were introduced; the division of labour between the National Guard and the security agencies was redrawn, and the combat experience of the Ukrainian security forces became the driving force of that military reform. The second is the international order: this was the first large interstate war in Europe since the Second World War, the OSCE monitoring mechanism and the Minsk Protocols became templates repeatedly invoked in later discussions of international intervention and ceasefire design, and at the same time the geopolitical division of European security was fixed again in the east; the Russian annexation of Crimea and the intervention that followed were treated by the mainstream Western security institutions as a break with the post-war European order, and the sanctions of the European Union and the United States, the rise in European defence spending and the reinforcement of NATO's eastern flank all rested on that premise. The third is Donbas society itself: the two republics kept a de facto state running, with a grey economy in which military materiel was exchanged for recognition, schools switched to teaching in Russian, and passports and currency gradually tied to Russia; the population along the line lived for years under shelling, power cuts and checkpoints, millions were displaced, and the regeneration of volunteers and mercenaries became part of the local economy. The fourth is the change in the form of war: after 2014 this line was driven by the real-time transmission of drone footage, social media and edited video, and for the first time the whole of a war entered global opinion at the moment of firing, so the propaganda, memory and legitimacy struggle of war became as important as its firepower; and the full-scale invasion of 24 February 2022 took the Donbas war as its own military and political premise.
result: 分階段來看。第一階段的二〇一四年夏季，烏軍的裝甲縱隊在頓涅茨克州南部與盧甘斯克州北部受挫，兩個「人民共和國」未被消滅，烏克蘭的戰線從州界內退到以城市為核心的縱深防禦；九月《明斯克協議》第一階段確定了九月停火線與權力下放的方向，但雙方在「全面撤軍」與「地方自治並舉行選舉」之間沒有交集，協議的執行機制從一開始就不完整。第二階段，二〇一五年一月的德爾巴爾切沃攻勢顯示烏軍有能力以小規模部隊切斷敵方走廊，但二月十五日停火生效時，烏方未能收復德爾巴爾切沃與斯捷爾諾沃霍爾斯克等城鎮，兩個政權保留了全部控制區；二〇一五年十月的地方選舉在烏方不承認下如期舉行，選舉本身的合法性成為永久爭議，其後的《明斯克協議》第二階段與二〇一六年、二〇一七年的停火安排只是把衝突凍結在原地，取代不了政治解決。戰術結果上，分離武裝失去大片農地與工廠地帶，人口與兵源接近枯竭，卻靠俄羅斯的供給維持了一支正軌化的軍隊；烏克蘭則以時間換取了裝備現代化與歐洲化編制的完成。第三階段，二〇二二年二月二十四日之後的全面入侵改寫了全局：同年夏天北頓涅茨克與呂赫揚斯克一線崩潰，馬里烏波爾在亞速鋼鐵廠的最後抵抗結束，四州在佔領下舉行公民投票並被俄方宣布併入，二〇二四年秋天戰線向波克羅夫斯克等方向推進，《明斯克協議》體系實質崩解。總的來說，二〇一四年之後這條戰線沒有任何一方能以軍事手段單獨決定歸屬：它把頓巴斯變成了一場持久的消耗戰，用砲火、巡飛彈與無人機而不是會戰來爭奪幾百平方公里的地面，而所有的勝負仍然留給未來的談判。
resultEn: The result has to be read stage by stage. In the first stage, the summer of 2014, the armoured columns of the Ukrainian army were checked in southern Donetsk and northern Luhansk, the two people's republics were not destroyed, and the Ukrainian line withdrew from inside the oblasts to a defence in depth built around the towns; the first Minsk Protocol of September 2014 fixed the September ceasefire line and the direction of power devolution, but the two sides had no overlap between 'complete withdrawal' and 'local autonomy with elections', and the enforcement mechanism of the agreement was incomplete from the outset. In the second stage, the Debaltseve offensive of January 2015 showed that the Ukrainian army could sever the enemy's corridor with a small force, but when the ceasefire took effect on 15 February the Ukrainians had not retaken Debaltseve, Svitlodarsk and other towns, and both entities kept their entire controlled territory; the local elections of October 2015 were held on schedule without Ukrainian recognition, the legitimacy of the vote itself became a permanent dispute, and the second Minsk Protocol and the arrangements of 2016 and 2017 did nothing but freeze the conflict where it stood, standing in for no political settlement. In tactical terms the separatist forces lost large tracts of farmland and industrial belt, their population and supply of recruits ran thin, yet they maintained a regularised army on Russian deliveries; the Ukraine bought, with time, the completion of its equipment modernisation and its Europeanised order of battle. The third stage, the full-scale invasion after 24 February 2022, rewrote the whole picture: in the summer of that year the line in northern Donetsk and Luhansk broke, the last resistance at the Azovstal works in Mariupol ended, the four oblasts held referendums under occupation and were proclaimed annexed by Russia, and in the autumn of 2024 the line pushed towards places such as Pokrovsk, with the Minsk system effectively collapsing. In the end, after 2014 no side on this line could settle the question by military means alone. Donbas became a war of attrition fought with artillery, loitering munitions and drones rather than with set-piece battles, fought over a few hundred square kilometres of ground, while the actual outcome was left to negotiations still to come.
